clauses.text: Every pressure vessel shall be protected by a pressure relief device.
Relief devices shall not discharge flammable vapour to atmosphere.

derogation.justification: Existing vent to a safe location 18 m above grade; flare tie-in not available before the next turnaround.

consequence.scenario: Vent release ignites on a calm day and a flash fire reaches the adjacent pump house.

political.note: local authority already informed of the vent

economic.note: pump house outage about 10 days, lost throughput

technological.note: detection depends on one gas detector type

legal.note: possible improvement notice if the permit condition on vents is read strictly

management_actions.economic: spare pump held on site; business interruption cover confirmed
management_actions.legal: permit condition reviewed with the regulator before approval

clauses.text: A high level trip shall be independent of the control system.

derogation.justification: Shared logic solver accepted for the pilot phase.

clauses.text: The relief valve inlet line should be as short as practicable.

derogation.justification: Inlet loss 2.1% of set pressure with the longer route; below the 3% limit.

consequence.scenario: Valve chatter if the line is later extended.

clauses.text: Fire-water monitors should be remotely operable.
A second level transmitter may be installed for diagnostics.
The operator shall notify the authority before start-up.
